preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 3*10**5 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Each test case has a length of the sequence between 2 and 300,000.
The total sum of all sequence lengths across all test cases does not exceed 300,000.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output[i]) == ns[i] for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: The number of integers in each output sequence matches the corresponding input length.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= a <= 10**9 for a in output[i]) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: All integers in each output sequence are between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(output[i])) == ns[i] for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: All integers in each output sequence are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(max(output[i]) - min(output[i]) == int((sum(output[i]))**0.5) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: The difference between the maximum and minimum integers in each output sequence equals the square root of their sum.
